backend/main.mo: Motoko actor handling user profiles, role-based access control, admin allowlist checks, signup flows, report storage, and system reset logic.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence document mapping a deployment feature to related files, components, and tests with high confidence.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of various frontend files describing styling, components, pages, deployment docs, and behavior.
frontend/ANDROID_TWA_BUILD.md: Guide for packaging the PWA as an Android app using Trusted Web Activity, including prerequisites, asset checks, Bubblewrap steps, and manual setup.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Deployment instructions for local and mainnet environments with deterministic build version requirements and post-deploy tests.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base styles defining OKLCH-driven design tokens for light and dark modes with global CSS variables.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point loading the app root, manifest, icons, theme color, and main script.
frontend/public/manifest.webmanifest: PWA manifest defining app metadata, start URL, theme colors, display mode, and required 192x192 and 512x512 icons.
frontend/public/sw.js: Service worker handling versioned precaching, runtime caching, skip-waiting, cache cleanup, and network-first/static-first fetch strategies.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app router logic that manages authentication state, profile loading, session validation, and conditional rendering of screens.
frontend/src/components/AccessDeniedScre: Displays an admin‑only access restriction message with a button to return home.
frontend/src/components/AppHeader.tsx: Top navigation bar showing branding, user info, admin links, and logout and copy‑to‑clipboard actions.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: App-wide layout wrapper providing header, offline/update banners, content area, and footer with build info.
frontend/src/components/LoginScreen.tsx: Login/signup screen using Internet Identity with handling for stale sessions and account switching.
frontend/src/components/OfflineBanner.ts: Shows an alert banner when the user is offline.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx: Signup form for creating engineer or admin profiles with validation and backend mutations.
frontend/src/components/ServiceWorkerUpd: Banner prompting users to reload when a new service worker version is available.
frontend/src/components/SessionInvalidSc: Renders a screen informing the user their session is invalid and triggers a full logout flow.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the backend actor based on Internet Identity, invalidating dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useFullLogout.ts: Provides a full logout routine that clears identity, caches, and reloads the page.
frontend/src/hooks/useGeolocation.ts: Captures the user's geolocation with timeout handling and exposes status, data, and reset functions.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Manages Internet Identity authentication, storing identity, login state, and providing login/clear methods.
frontend/src/hooks/useNetworkStatus.ts: Tracks network online/offline status using browser events.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for user profiles, signups, admin checks, and related backend interactions.
frontend/src/hooks/useServiceWorkerUpdat: Detects service worker updates and provides a method to apply and activate new versions.
frontend/src/index.css: Configures Tailwind and theme variables for light/dark modes with industrial color palette.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/pages/AdminUsersPage.tsx: Admin UI for listing users, deleting accounts, purging legacy data, and resetting the app, including dialogs and authorization checks.
frontend/src/pages/ReportDetailPage.tsx: Displays detailed information for a single service report with loading/error states and navigation back to history.
frontend/src/pages/ReportEntryPage.tsx: Form for creating a new service report with validation, geolocation capture, and submit handling.
frontend/src/pages/ReportHistoryPage.tsx: Lists and filters service reports with search, date range, user filtering, clipboard copy, and CSV download support.
frontend/src/utils/authErrorDetection.ts: Detects whether errors represent missing profiles or genuine authentication/session failures.
frontend/src/utils/authSessionCleanup.ts: Clears localStorage and sessionStorage keys related to Internet Identity to fully reset auth state.
frontend/src/utils/buildInfo.ts: Generates a build/version identifier for deployments, supporting environment overrides and fallbacks.
frontend/src/utils/copyToClipboard.ts: Utility to copy text to clipboard using modern API or a textarea fallback.
frontend/src/utils/formatPrincipal.ts: Provides helpers to format principal IDs and usernames for display.
frontend/src/utils/pwaCacheCleanup.ts: Clears all PWA Cache Storage entries with safe error handling.
frontend/src/utils/reportDownload.ts: Converts service reports to CSV and triggers a file download with a dated filename.
Parses and sanitizes backend signup errors into user-friendly messages.
frontend/src/utils/signupFlowDebug.ts: Sanitizes and logs signup-related events while redacting sensitive data.
frontend/src/utils/signupValidation.ts: Validates required signup fields including email and mobile number formats.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Manages URL and session-based parameters, including retrieval, persistence, and cleanup.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind CSS theme, colors, animations, and plugins.
project_state.json: Describes current project metadata, state version, and deployment feature info.
